sender.en: A “financial services company” offering remote part-time work

name.en: Part-time job that uses your bank account: “receive client payments and transfer them on”

how.en: An ad on social media offers flexible remote part-time work with quick income. After you apply you are “accepted” and asked to open a bank account or use your own “for administrative purposes”. Money starts arriving and you are told to transfer it quickly to other accounts for a commission. The money comes from crime, and Dubai Police question the account holder, who can face legal consequences. Some versions ask for registration or activation fees instead.

text.en: A remote part-time job ad promising quick, easy income.
The “employer” says they are a financial services company.
You are asked to use your bank account to receive and pass on money.
You must transfer each payment on quickly.

Hi! Your application for the remote Finance Assistant role has been accepted ✅ Your task: receive client payments in your bank account and transfer them to our partner accounts within 1 hour. You earn 3% commission on every transfer. Please share your account details to start today.

en: part time job asked me to use my bank account
they send money to my account and i transfer it on
police called me about transfers in my account
remote job asked me to open a new bank account
A job that needs your bank account to move other people's money.
Commission for each transfer you make.
Being asked to open a new account “for administrative purposes”.
Never let anyone use your bank account to receive or forward money.
If money arrives, don't forward it; tell your bank and the police.
Report the ad to the police.

sources.title: Dubai Police warn residents after man falls victim to part-time job fraud
UAE authority warns residents against fake job offers, recruitment scams

story.en: A young man saw an ad for a remote part-time job on social media and was told he had been accepted. The “employers”, posing as a financial services company, asked him to open an account or use his own. Money started arriving and he was asked to transfer it quickly to other accounts for a commission, with promises of a permanent job. Police called him in for questioning after reviewing the transfers; he said he had no idea he was working for a gang.
